versions.content: If the parameters in a call of TerminateApplication() are valid and the above criteria are met TerminateApplication() shall terminate <Application> (i.e. to kill all tasks, disable the interrupt sources of those ISRs which belong to the OS-Application and free all other OS resources associated with the application) AND shall activate the configured OsRestartTask of <Application> if <RestartOption> equals RESTART. If no OsRestartTask is configured, no restart shall happen. If the <Application> is restarted, its state is set to APPLICATION_RESTARTING otherwise to APPLICATION_TERMINATED. If the caller belongs to <Application> TerminateApplication() shall not return, otherwise it shall return E_OK.
